## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (lint, typecheck, build, tests with coverage at 100 percent)
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test
- [ ] User-facing changes have a line under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] No credential, token or private URL appears in the code, tests or this description

See CONTRIBUTING.md for the rules. A security fix goes through private vulnerability
reporting first (SECURITY.md), not a public pull request.
